# P11 · Cohort space, mentor items, coach moderation (reduced): tasks

**Goal (3 lines):** teachers in a cohort get a small moderated pseudonymous thread; coaches run the lifecycle and moderate; a mentor's items reach teachers only after the coach approves. Reduced scope: see DECISIONS 2026-10-27.

**Starting commit:** `707d7a2` · **Started:** 2026-10-27

- [x] **T01 · Posting check** (`ai/validators/thread.py`, `content/safety/child_names.yaml`; golden set in `tests/cohorts/test_cohort_space.py`: names in three scripts, roll numbers, relationship phrases, phone, email, harsh words, length; ordinary text passes)
- [x] **T02 · Lifecycle** (`services/api/cohorts/lifecycle.py`; legal and illegal transitions, close rule, audit rows, thread opens at 5, figures under 5 hidden)
- [x] **T03 · Thread and moderation** (`thread.py`; labels, failed check stores nothing, report holds, hide/restore/pin/erase audited, delete own, retention 7/30/90)
- [x] **T04 · Mentor items** (`mentor_items.py`; states, reason codes, screened note, in-use only after approval, new version on edit, coach only for her cohorts)
- [x] **T05 · API with role checks** (`routes.py`, `tests/cohorts/test_cohorts_api.py`: mentor own cohorts, cohort-level figures, coach assigned only, teacher and officer separation, no handle or teacher id in any response)
- [x] **T06 · Screen** (`#/cohort`, `apps/pwa/e2e/cohort.spec.ts`, API mocked)
- [x] **T07 · Docs** (`docs/cohort-space.md`, DECISIONS, PARKING; demo cohort in `scripts/seed_demo_track.py --cohort`)
- [ ] **Cut:** Telegram relay, voice, notifications, M1 recording flow, call 4, call 6 digest, mentor pages, real role assignment.
